question: Price makes a higher high at the end of the chart while RSI makes a lower high. What is this called and how should it be used?
options: A hidden bullish divergence that favours adding to long positions
Bearish (negative) divergence; a warning of fading momentum that needs price confirmation, such as a break of support
Bullish (positive) divergence; momentum is confirming the new high
Positive reversal; it signals the uptrend will accelerate
